description: This is a source file for the frontend of a notes management application, written with React and Remix framework. It defines data loading and action handlers, layout components, and main app component for rendering the interface, including a sidebar and content area.

methods.name: loader
methods.description: Provides the list of notes for the sidebar, with client-side handling after hydration.

methods.name: action
methods.description: Handles creating a new note upon user request, managing server and client-side differences.

methods.name: links
methods.description: Defines external stylesheets and font preloads for the app.

methods.name: Layout
methods.description: Main layout component wrapping the app's UI, handles navigation state and includes metadata, styles, and loading indicators.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main application component, rendering sidebar and content area with dynamic data.
